name: Three Spanish guitars for a corporate event: Entre dos Aguas
description: Three flamenco guitarists take turns on Entre dos Aguas. Dirty Flamenco can play as three guitars, and it makes a great feature at a corporate event.
more: At a corporate dinner, a short flamenco performance can be the high point, and we'll plan it around your program. Dirty Flamenco is a great pick for member and association events, too, where flamenco adds some color and a sense of occasion.
